label: Chapter 06

sentences.en: The best periods of my life always came after a period of getting absolutely fed up with the lack of progress in my life.
sentences.zh: 我人生中最好的阶段，总是在我对生活毫无进展感到彻底厌倦之后到来。

sentences.en: My best writing, my best ideas, and my best work also came in the short periods after I got fed up.
sentences.zh: 我最好的文字、最好的想法和最好的作品，也都诞生于我感到厌倦之后的那段短暂时期。

sentences.en: When you are so sick of running in circles, you think about your life for a long time and it becomes a sort of awakening.
sentences.zh: 当你厌倦了原地打转，你会长时间地思考自己的人生，而这会成为某种觉醒。

sentences.en: How do you dig into your mind?
sentences.zh: 你如何深入挖掘自己的内心？

sentences.en: How do you become aware of your conditioning?
sentences.zh: 你如何意识到自己的条件反射式思维？

sentences.en: How do you reach profound insights and truths that change the trajectory of your life?
sentences.zh: 你如何获得那些足以改变人生轨迹的深刻洞见与真相？

sentences.en: Through the simple, but often painful act of questioning.
sentences.zh: 通过提问这一简单却常常令人痛苦的行动。

sentences.en: Something that so few people do, and you can tell by how they speak or give their thoughts on a specific subject.
sentences.zh: 很少有人这样做，从他们说话的方式、或对某个话题发表看法的方式就能看出来。

sentences.en: Their answers reveal how they see the world and others.
sentences.zh: 他们的回答揭示了他们如何看待世界和他人。

sentences.en: They simply said what they read on the internet and are able to regurgitate it cleanly.
sentences.zh: 他们只是把在网上读到的东西复述出来，而且能复述得很流利。

sentences.en: They rarely ask questions that are worth asking, and ask them only for the sake of seeming interesting.
sentences.zh: 他们很少提出真正值得问的问题，提问只是为了显得有趣。

sentences.en: I want to give you a comprehensive protocol that you can use every year to reset your life and launch into a completely new chapter.
sentences.zh: 我想给你一套全面的方法，你可以每年用它来重置人生，开启全新的篇章。

sentences.en: This isn't another "self-help" list.
sentences.zh: 这不是又一份“自助”清单。

sentences.en: This is a psychological excavation.
sentences.zh: 这是一次心理挖掘。

sentences.en: These questions will cover the macro to the micro: where you want to be, what you need to do to get there, what you need to do to stay there, and how you actually want to live once you are there.
sentences.zh: 这些问题将从宏观覆盖到微观：你想去向何方、为到达那里需要做什么、为留在那里需要做什么，以及到达之后你真正想如何生活。

sentences.en: This will require one full day to complete, so I recommend you follow along with the exact protocol.
sentences.zh: 这需要整整一天来完成，所以我建议你严格按照这套方法来做。

sentences.en: When I observe patterns in people who successfully flip their identity, it happens fast after a build-up of dissonance, followed by uncertainty, followed by discovery.
sentences.zh: 当我观察那些成功转变身份的人身上的规律时，我发现，转变总是在失调感积累到一定程度之后迅速发生，随后是不确定性，再随后是发现。

sentences.en: 1. Dissonance – They feel like they don't belong in their current life, and become sufficiently fed up with it. They then realize what life they want.
sentences.zh: 1. 失调——他们觉得自己不属于现在的生活，并对此感到足够厌倦。随后，他们意识到自己想要什么样的生活。

sentences.en: 2. Uncertainty – They don't know what comes next, so they either experiment or get lost and feel worse.
sentences.zh: 2. 不确定——他们不知道接下来会发生什么，于是要么去尝试，要么迷失方向、感觉更糟。

sentences.en: 3. Discovery – They discover what they want to pursue and make 6 years of progress in 6 months.
sentences.zh: 3. 发现——他们发现了自己想要追求的事，并在6个月里取得了6年的进展。

sentences.en: So, our goal with this protocol is to help you reach the point of dissonance, navigate through uncertainty, and reach discovery.
sentences.zh: 所以，这套方法的目标是帮助你抵达失调的临界点，穿越不确定性，抵达发现。

sentences.en: This protocol is structured so that it can be completed in one day.
sentences.zh: 这套方法的结构设计成可以在一天内完成。

sentences.en: In the morning, you do a psychological excavation.
sentences.zh: 早上，你做一次心理挖掘。

sentences.en: Throughout the day, you interrupt autopilot.
sentences.zh: 白天，你打断自动驾驶模式。

sentences.en: And in the evening, you synthesize insight.
sentences.zh: 晚上，你整合洞见。

sentences.en: I cannot guarantee that this will work for everyone, because I cannot guarantee that everyone reading this is in the right chapter of their life.
sentences.zh: 我无法保证这对每个人都有效，因为我无法保证每个读到这篇文章的人都正处在人生的正确章节。

sentences.en: This is a specific kind of protocol for a specific type of person.
sentences.zh: 这是一套针对特定类型的人的特定方法。

sentences.en: If you are in the right chapter of your life, this exercise will feel like a massive release.
sentences.zh: 如果你正处在人生的正确章节，这项练习会让你感到如释重负。

sentences.en: If you are not, it may not be very useful.
sentences.zh: 如果不是，它可能没什么用。

sentences.en: Part 1) Morning – Psychological Excavation – Vision & Anti-Vision
sentences.zh: 第一部分）早上——心理挖掘——愿景与反愿景

sentences.en: First we must create a new frame, or lens of perception, for your mind to operate from.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们必须为你的心智建立一个新的框架，或感知透镜，让它以此为基础运转。

sentences.en: This is like creating a new shell, leaving your old one, and slowly growing into it over time.
sentences.zh: 这就像造一个新的壳，离开旧的壳，再随着时间慢慢长进新壳里。

sentences.en: It won't happen instantly.
sentences.zh: 这不会一蹴而就。

sentences.en: You must keep exposing yourself to new information that forms your goals, and you must keep moving toward the goals you want to achieve.
sentences.zh: 你必须不断接触能塑造你目标的新信息，也必须不断朝着你想实现的目标前进。

sentences.en: Set aside 15-30 minutes (the length of one YouTube video... you can do it) to think about and answer these questions.
sentences.zh: 留出15-30分钟（也就是一个YouTube视频的长度……你做得到的）来思考并回答这些问题。

sentences.en: It may be painful and some answers may stir up unhelpful emotions.
sentences.zh: 这可能会很痛苦，有些答案可能会激起一些无益的情绪。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: It's the price of admission that grants you access to a new chapter of life.
sentences.zh: 这是通往人生新篇章的入场费。

sentences.en: Have a journal, a notepad, a sheet of paper, or whatever you need, and answer them with brutal honesty.
sentences.zh: 准备一本日记、一个记事本、一张纸，或任何你需要的东西，并以残酷的诚实回答它们。

sentences.en: 1. What is the dull and persistent dissatisfaction you've learned to live with? Not the deep suffering that keeps you up at night. Just the low-grade, quiet, everyday annoyance that you pretend isn't there.
sentences.zh: 1. 是什么让你感到沉闷而持续的不满，以至于你已经学会与它共存？不是那种让你夜不能寐的深切痛苦。只是那种低烈度的、安静的、日常的烦恼，你假装它不存在。

sentences.en: 2. What do you complain about repeatedly but never actually change? Write down the three complaints you hear yourself say most often. These are your highest-leverage problems.
sentences.zh: 2. 你反复抱怨却从不真正改变的是什么？写下你听到自己说得最多的三个抱怨。这些就是你杠杆最高的问题。

sentences.en: 3. For each complaint: What would someone who watched your behavior (not your words) conclude that you actually want? (For example, you say you want to be fit, but your behavior says you want to be comfortable, or you say you want to quit your job, but your behavior says you want to avoid the discomfort of change.)
sentences.zh: 3. 针对每个抱怨：如果有人只观察你的行为（而不是你的话），他会推断你真正想要什么？（例如，你说你想变健康，但你的行为表明你想要舒适；或者你说你想辞职，但你的行为表明你想避免改变带来的不适。）

sentences.en: 4. What truth about your current life would be unbearable to admit to someone you deeply respect?
sentences.zh: 4. 关于你目前的生活，有什么真相是你无法忍受向一位你深深尊敬的人承认的？

sentences.en: Those questions are meant to make you aware of the pain in your current life.
sentences.zh: 这些问题旨在让你意识到当前生活中的痛苦。

sentences.en: Now, we need to turn that pain into fuel for change.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们需要把这种痛苦转化为改变的燃料。

sentences.en: Answer these questions, and don't hold back.
sentences.zh: 回答这些问题，不要有所保留。

sentences.en: You can write something and immediately delete it if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意，可以写下来然后立刻删掉。

sentences.en: There is no shame in this.
sentences.zh: 这没有什么可羞耻的。

sentences.en: No one will ever see it.
sentences.zh: 没有人会看到它。

sentences.en: 1. If absolutely nothing changes for the next five years, describe an average Tuesday. Where do you wake up? What do you do? Who are you with? What does your bank account look like?
sentences.zh: 1. 如果未来五年什么都不改变，描述一个普通的星期二。你在哪里醒来？你做什么？你和谁在一起？你的银行账户是什么样子？

sentences.en: 2. Now do it but for ten years. What have you missed? What opportunities closed? Who gave up on you? What did your life become?
sentences.zh: 2. 现在把它延长到十年。你错过了什么？哪些机会关闭了？谁对你失望了？你的生活变成了什么样子？

sentences.en: 3. You're at the end of your life. You lived the safe version. You never broke the pattern. What was the cost? What did you lose that you can never get back?
sentences.zh: 3. 你走到了生命的尽头。你活的是安全的版本。你从未打破这个模式。代价是什么？你失去了什么再也无法挽回的东西？

sentences.en: 4. Who in your life is already living the future you just described? Someone five, ten, twenty years ahead of you who took the safe path. What does their life really look like?
sentences.zh: 4. 你身边有谁已经在过你刚才描述的未来？比你领先五年、十年、二十年、走了安全道路的那个人。他的生活真正是什么样子？

sentences.en: 5. What identity would you have to give up to actually change? ("I am the type of person who...") What would it cost you socially to no longer be that person?
sentences.zh: 5. 要真正改变，你必须放弃什么样的身份？（“我是那种……的人。”）不再做那个人，会让你在社交上付出什么代价？

sentences.en: 6. What is the most embarrassing reason you haven't changed? The one that makes you sound weak, scared, or unmotivated. Find it. Write it down.
sentences.zh: 6. 你迟迟没有改变的最令人难堪的原因是什么？那个让你听起来软弱、害怕或缺乏动力的原因。找到它。写下来。

sentences.en: 7. If your current behavior is a form of self-protection, what exactly are you protecting? And what is it costing you to keep protecting it?
sentences.zh: 7. 如果你当前的行为是一种自我保护，你到底在保护什么？而继续保护它又让你付出了什么代价？

sentences.en: If you answered those truthfully, and if you are in the right chapter of your life, you will feel a deep sense of discomfort.
sentences.zh: 如果你如实回答了这些问题，并且你正处在人生的正确章节，你会感到一种深深的不适。

sentences.en: And if you don't feel discomfort, you either didn't answer honestly, or you aren't in the right chapter, and that's okay.
sentences.zh: 而如果你没有感到不适，要么是你没有诚实回答，要么是你不在正确的章节，这也没关系。

sentences.en: Something important: do not answer the vision questions first.
sentences.zh: 重要的一点：不要先回答愿景问题。

sentences.en: If you have no anti-vision and no dissatisfaction, your vision will be shallow.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有反愿景、没有不满，你的愿景就会很肤浅。

sentences.en: Now that we've established the pain, let's establish the vision.
sentences.zh: 既然我们已经确立了痛苦，接下来让我们确立愿景。

sentences.en: Your anti-vision is the pain, your vision is the pleasure.
sentences.zh: 你的反愿景就是痛苦，你的愿景就是快乐。

sentences.en: Answer these questions with complete honesty.
sentences.zh: 以完全的诚实回答这些问题。

sentences.en: 1. Forget practicality for a minute. If you could snap your fingers and be living a different life in the next 3 months, what would that life look like? What does an average Tuesday look like? Same level of detail as question 5.
sentences.zh: 1. 先忘掉现实可行性一分钟。如果你能打个响指，在接下来的3个月里过上另一种生活，那种生活会是什么样子？一个普通的星期二会是什么样子？细节程度与第5题相同。

sentences.en: 2. What would you have to believe about yourself for that life to feel natural rather than forced? Write an "I am the type of person who..." statement for your future self.
sentences.zh: 2. 要让那种生活感觉自然而不是勉强，你必须相信自己是什么样的人？为未来的自己写一句“我是那种……的人”的陈述。

sentences.en: 3. What is one thing you would do this week if you were already that person?
sentences.zh: 3. 如果你已经是那个人，本周你会做的一件事是什么？

sentences.en: Answer all of those first thing in the morning tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天早上第一件事，先回答所有这些问题。

sentences.en: Part 2) Throughout The Day – Interrupting Autopilot – Breaking Unconscious Patterns
sentences.zh: 第二部分）全天——打断自动驾驶——打破无意识模式

sentences.en: These journaling exercises are cute, but we want real change.
sentences.zh: 这些写日记的练习固然不错，但我们想要的是真正的改变。

sentences.en: Frankly, that's not going to happen if you don't break the current unconscious patterns that are keeping you there.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，如果你不打破那些让你停留在原地的无意识模式，真正的改变就不会发生。

sentences.en: These patterns are broken by disrupting your default, on autopilot behavior.
sentences.zh: 这些模式要靠打乱你默认的、自动驾驶的行为来打破。

sentences.en: Throughout the day, I want you to contemplate on everything you journaled in part one.
sentences.zh: 在这一天里，我希望你思考你在第一部分中写下的所有内容。

sentences.en: Beyond that, you should set alarms throughout the day to remind yourself of the questions that need answering.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，你应该在全天设置闹钟，提醒自己回答那些需要回答的问题。

sentences.en: Take the time right now to create reminders or calendar events in your phone.
sentences.zh: 现在就花点时间，在手机里创建提醒或日历事件。

sentences.en: Include the question in each reminder.
sentences.zh: 在每个提醒里都包含那个问题。

sentences.en: Here are some example times + questions to copy and paste (of which you can use your own questions too):
sentences.zh: 以下是一些可以直接复制粘贴的示例时间+问题（你也可以用自己的问题）：

sentences.en: The more random and non-conflicting with your schedule there are, the better.
sentences.zh: 闹钟越随机、越不与你的日程冲突，效果越好。

sentences.en: 11:00am: What am I avoiding right now by doing what I'm doing?
sentences.zh: 11:00am：我现在做的事，是在逃避什么？

sentences.en: 1:30pm: If someone filmed the last two hours, what would they conclude I want from my life?
sentences.zh: 1:30pm：如果有人拍下了过去两个小时，他会从中推断出我想要什么样的生活？

sentences.en: 3:15pm: Am I moving toward the life I hate or the life I want?
sentences.zh: 3:15pm：我是在走向我讨厌的生活，还是我想要的生活？

sentences.en: 5:00pm: What's the most important thing I'm pretending isn't important?
sentences.zh: 5:00pm：我假装不重要的事中，最重要的是什么？

sentences.en: 7:30pm: What did I do today out of identity protection rather than genuine desire? (Hint: it's most things.)
sentences.zh: 7:30pm：今天我做的哪些事是出于保护身份，而不是真正的渴望？（提示：大多数都是。）

sentences.en: 9:00pm: When did I feel most alive today? When did I feel most dead?
sentences.zh: 9:00pm：今天我什么时候感到最有活力？什么时候感到最没有生气？

sentences.en: To add a bit more fuel to the fire, schedule these questions during times where you are either commuting, sitting in a meeting, or scrolling on your phone.
sentences.zh: 为了再添一把火，在你通勤、开会或刷手机的时候安排这些问题。

sentences.en: The more you can interject those questions into your autopilot behavior, the better.
sentences.zh: 你越能把这些问题插入你的自动驾驶行为中，效果越好。

sentences.en: What would change if I stopped needing people to see me as [the identity you wrote in question 10]?
sentences.zh: 如果我不再需要别人把我看作[你在第10题中写下的那个身份]，会发生什么变化？

sentences.en: Where in my life am I trading aliveness for safety?
sentences.zh: 在我的生活中，我在哪些地方用活力换取了安全感？

sentences.en: What's the smallest version of the person I want to become that I could be tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 我想成为的那个人，最小的版本是什么？明天我就能成为的那个版本。

sentences.en: Part 3) Evening – Synthesizing Insight – Entering A Season Of Progress
sentences.zh: 第三部分）晚上——整合洞见——进入一个进步的季节

sentences.en: If you followed that process, I would be surprised if you didn't have at least one profound insight that changes how you see your life.
sentences.zh: 如果你照着这个流程做了，我会很惊讶你竟然没有至少获得一个改变你看待人生方式的深刻洞见。

sentences.en: Write it down now.
sentences.zh: 现在就把它写下来。

sentences.en: 1. After today, what feels most true about why you've been stuck?
sentences.zh: 1. 经历了今天，关于你为什么一直停滞不前，什么感觉最真实？

sentences.en: 2. What is the actual enemy? Name it clearly. Not circumstances. Not other people. The internal pattern that keeps you in a loop.
sentences.zh: 2. 真正的敌人是什么？清楚地给它命名。不是环境。不是别人。是让你不断循环的内在模式。

sentences.en: 3. Write a single sentence that captures what you refuse to let your life become. This is your anti-vision.
sentences.zh: 3. 写一句话，概括你拒绝让自己的人生变成的样子。这是你的反愿景。

sentences.en: 4. Write a single sentence that captures what you're building toward, knowing it will evolve. This is your vision.
sentences.zh: 4. 写一句话，概括你正在朝着什么努力建设，同时知道它会不断演变。这是你的愿景。

sentences.en: Lastly, we need to create goals.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们需要制定目标。

sentences.en: Again, these aren't goals that you set for the sake of achievement, because goals are just projections of your identity onto the future.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这些目标不是为了成就而设定的，因为目标只是你的身份投射到未来。

sentences.en: It's just a way to expand your goals and give your mind a framework to operate within.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种扩展你的目标、给你的心智一个运转框架的方式。

sentences.en: It might look like this:
sentences.zh: 它可能看起来像这样：

sentences.en: 1. One-year lens: What would have to be true in one year for you to know you've broken the old pattern?
sentences.zh: 1. 一年视角：一年后，什么必须成真，你才能知道自己已经打破了旧模式？

sentences.en: 2. One-month lens: What would have to be true in one month for the one-year lens to remain possible?
sentences.zh: 2. 一个月视角：一个月后，什么必须成真，一年视角才仍然可能实现？

sentences.en: 3. Daily lens: What are 2-3 actions you can timeblock tomorrow that the person you're becoming would simply do as a normal part of their day?
sentences.zh: 3. 每日视角：明天你可以安排哪2-3个行动，是那个正在成为的你会作为日常生活的一部分自然而然去做的？

sentences.en: That was a lot.
sentences.zh: 就这么多。

sentences.en: Hopefully it was helpful.
sentences.zh: 希望这对你有帮助。

sentences.en: But we have one last piece to lock it all in.
sentences.zh: 但我们还有最后一块拼图要把它锁定。

sentences.en: Stick with me.
sentences.zh: 跟着我。

title_en: VI – How to launch into a completely new life (in 1 day)
title_zh: 六、如何用一天开启全新的人生

vocab.example_en: There was a growing dissonance between the life she wanted and the life she was living.

vocab.def_zh: 照搬；机械复述（读到的东西）
vocab.example_en: He could regurgitate the textbook, but he had never really thought about the ideas.
The project began with a careful excavation of her old habits and beliefs.
One small decision can change the trajectory of a whole career.

vocab.def_zh: 条件作用；长期形成的思维或行为模式
vocab.example_en: Years of conditioning had taught him to avoid taking risks.
